changeSet.comment: Radiology Order refactor: create an Exam Location order attribute type, backed by core's LocationDatatype, to replace the exam_location column previously stored on the now-retired emr_radiology_order table

column.name: description
column.value: Location to send a portable exam machine to

changeSet.author: mgoodrich
changeSet.comment: Radiology Order refactor: migrate exam_location values from emr_radiology_order into order_attribute rows (using the new Exam Location order attribute type inserted above), storing the referenced location's uuid as the value_reference, as expected by LocationDatatype
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO order_attribute (order_id, attribute_type_id, value_reference, uuid, creator, date_created, voided) SELECT ro.order_id, (select order_attribute_type_id from order_attribute_type where uuid = 'af127936-e165-44d2-a4e2-352dbbf7f834'), loc.uuid, UUID(), 1, NOW(), 0 FROM emr_radiology_order ro INNER JOIN location loc ON loc.location_id = ro.exam_location WHERE ro.exam_location IS NOT NULL
